039        public static boolean setDHull(ShipVariantAPI variant) {
040                //if (!variant.getHullSpec().isDHull()) {
041                variant.setSource(VariantSource.REFIT);
042                //if (!variant.isDHull()) {
043                if (!variant.getHullSpec().isDefaultDHull()) {
044                        String dHullId = Misc.getDHullId(variant.getHullSpec());
045                        ShipHullSpecAPI dHull = Global.getSettings().getHullSpec(dHullId);
046                        variant.setHullSpecAPI(dHull);
047                        return true;
048                }
049                return false;
050        }

052        public static int reduceNextDmodsBy = 0;

055         * This is the d-mods post combat method.

057        public static void addDMods(FleetMemberData data, boolean own, CampaignFleetAPI recoverer, Random random) {
058                addDMods(data.getMember(), data.getStatus() == Status.DESTROYED, own, recoverer, random);
059        }

061        public static void addDMods(FleetMemberAPI member, boolean destroyed, boolean own, CampaignFleetAPI recoverer, Random random) {
062                ShipVariantAPI variant = member.getVariant();
063                addDMods(variant, destroyed, own, recoverer, random);
064        }
065        public static void addDMods(ShipVariantAPI variant, boolean destroyed, boolean own, CampaignFleetAPI recoverer, Random random) {
066                //int original = getNumDMods(variant);
067                if (random == null) random = new Random();
068                
069//              if (own) {
070//                      System.out.println("323ffwe");
071//              }
072                DModAdderParams params = new DModAdderParams();
073                params.variant = variant;
074                params.destroyed = destroyed;
075                params.own = own;
076                params.recoverer = recoverer;
077                params.random = random;
078                DModAdderPlugin plugin = Global.getSector().getGenericPlugins().pickPlugin(DModAdderPlugin.class, params);
079                if (plugin != null) {
080                        plugin.addDMods(params);
081                        return;
082                }
083                
084                
085                if (destroyed) {
086                        addAllPermaModsWithTags(variant, Tags.HULLMOD_DESTROYED_ALWAYS);
087//                      if (own) {
088//                              int added = getNumDMods(variant) - original;
089//                              if (added > 0) return;
090//                      }
091                }
092                
093//              if (member.getHullSpec().getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.CIVILIAN)) {
094//                      addAllPermaModsWithTags(variant, Tags.HULLMOD_CIV_ALWAYS);
095//              }
096
097                List<HullModSpecAPI> potentialMods = getModsWithTags(Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE);
098                removeUnsuitedMods(variant, potentialMods);
099                
100                boolean hasStructDamage = getNumDMods(variant, Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE_STRUCT) > 0;
101                if (hasStructDamage) {
102                        potentialMods = getModsWithoutTags(potentialMods, Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE_STRUCT);
103                }
104                
105                //if (variant.getHullSpec().getFighterBays() > 0 || variant.isCarrier()) {
106                if (variant.getHullSpec().getFighterBays() > 0) {
107                        potentialMods.addAll(getModsWithTags(Tags.HULLMOD_FIGHTER_BAY_DAMAGE));
108                }
109                //if (variant.getHullSpec().getDefenseType() == ShieldType.PHASE) {
110                if (variant.getHullSpec().isPhase()) {
111                        potentialMods.addAll(getModsWithTags(Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE_PHASE));
112                }
113                
114//              if (variant.isCarrier()) {
115//                      if (own || true) { // bit too harsh to always add damaged flight decks to recovered enemy carriers
116//                              potentialMods.addAll(getModsWithTags(Tags.HULLMOD_CARRIER_ALWAYS));
117//                      } else {
118//                              addAllPermaModsWithTags(variant, Tags.HULLMOD_CARRIER_ALWAYS);
119//                      }
120//              }
121                
122                removeModsAlreadyInVariant(variant, potentialMods);
123                
124                int num = 2 + random.nextInt(3);
125                
126                int reduction = 0;
127                reduction += reduceNextDmodsBy;
128                reduceNextDmodsBy = 0;
129                if (recoverer != null) {
130                        int extra = (int) recoverer.getStats().getDynamic().getValue(Stats.SHIP_DMOD_REDUCTION, 0);
131                        if (extra >= 0) {
132                                extra = random.nextInt(extra + 1);
133                        } else {
134                                extra = -1 * random.nextInt(-extra + 1);
135                        }
136                        reduction += extra;
137                }
138                
139                num -= reduction;
140                if (num < 1) num = 1;
141                
142                int already = getNumDMods(variant);
143                
144                int add = num - already;
145                if (own) {
146                        add = (1 - reduction);
147                }
148                
149                if (add + already > MAX_DMODS_FROM_COMBAT) {
150                        add = MAX_DMODS_FROM_COMBAT - already;
151                }
152                if (add <= 0) return;
153
154                
155                WeightedRandomPicker<HullModSpecAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<HullModSpecAPI>(random);
156                picker.addAll(potentialMods);
157                for (int i = 0; i < add && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
158                        HullModSpecAPI pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
159                        if (pick != null) {
160                                if (pick.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE_STRUCT) && getNumDMods(variant, Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE_STRUCT) > 0) {
161                                        i--;
162                                        continue;
163                                }
164                                variant.removeSuppressedMod(pick.getId());
165                                variant.addPermaMod(pick.getId(), false);
166                        }
167                }
168        }

171        public static void addDMods(FleetMemberAPI member, boolean canAddDestroyedMods, int num, Random random) {
172                ShipVariantAPI variant = member.getVariant();
173                addDMods(variant, canAddDestroyedMods, num, random);
174        }

176        public static void addDMods(ShipVariantAPI variant, boolean canAddDestroyedMods, int num, Random random) {
177                addDMods(variant, canAddDestroyedMods, num, null, false, random);
178        }
179        public static void addDMods(ShipVariantAPI variant, boolean canAddDestroyedMods, int num, 
180                                                                                                String excludeTag, boolean allowNonCivOnCiv, Random random) {
181                if (random == null) random = new Random();
182                
183                DModAdderParams params = new DModAdderParams();
184                params.variant = variant;
185                params.canAddDestroyedMods = canAddDestroyedMods;
186                params.num = num;
187                params.excludeTag = excludeTag;
188                params.random = random;
189                DModAdderPlugin plugin = Global.getSector().getGenericPlugins().pickPlugin(DModAdderPlugin.class, params);
190                if (plugin != null) {
191                        plugin.addDMods(params);
192                        return;
193                }
194                
195                
196//              if (member.getHullSpec().getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.CIVILIAN)) {
197//                      int added = addAllPermaModsWithTags(variant, Tags.HULLMOD_CIV_ALWAYS);
198//                      if (added > 0) {
199//                              num -= added;
200//                              if (num <= 0) return;
201//                      }
202//              }
203                
204                List<HullModSpecAPI> potentialMods = getModsWithTags(Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE);
205                if (canAddDestroyedMods) potentialMods.addAll(getModsWithTags(Tags.HULLMOD_DESTROYED_ALWAYS));
206                
207                removeUnsuitedMods(variant, potentialMods, allowNonCivOnCiv);
208                
209                boolean hasStructDamage = getNumDMods(variant, Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE_STRUCT) > 0;
210                if (hasStructDamage) {
211                        potentialMods = getModsWithoutTags(potentialMods, Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE_STRUCT);
212                }
213                
214                if (variant.getHullSpec().getFighterBays() > 0) {
215                //if (variant.getHullSpec().getFighterBays() > 0 || variant.isCarrier()) {                      
216                        potentialMods.addAll(getModsWithTags(Tags.HULLMOD_FIGHTER_BAY_DAMAGE));
217                }
218                //if (variant.getHullSpec().getDefenseType() == ShieldType.PHASE) {
219                if (variant.getHullSpec().isPhase()) {
220                        potentialMods.addAll(getModsWithTags(Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE_PHASE));
221                }
222                
223                if (variant.isCarrier()) {
224                        potentialMods.addAll(getModsWithTags(Tags.HULLMOD_CARRIER_ALWAYS));
225                }
226                
227                if (excludeTag != null) {
228                        potentialMods.removeIf(mod -> mod.hasTag(excludeTag));
229                }
230                
231                potentialMods = new ArrayList<HullModSpecAPI>(potentialMods);
232                
233                removeModsAlreadyInVariant(variant, potentialMods);
234                
235//              System.out.println("");
236//              System.out.println("Adding: ");
237                WeightedRandomPicker<HullModSpecAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<HullModSpecAPI>(random);
238                picker.addAll(potentialMods);
239                int added = 0;
240                for (int i = 0; i < num && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
241                        HullModSpecAPI pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
242                        if (pick != null) {
243                                if (pick.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE_STRUCT) && getNumDMods(variant, Tags.HULLMOD_DAMAGE_STRUCT) > 0) {
244                                        i--;
245                                        continue;
246                                }
247                                variant.removeSuppressedMod(pick.getId());
248                                variant.addPermaMod(pick.getId(), false);
249                                //System.out.println("Mod: " + pick.getId());
250                                added++;
251                        }
252                }
253//              if (getNumDMods(variant) < 5) {
254//                      System.out.println("ewfwefew");
255//              }
256        }

259        public static boolean assumeAllShipsAreAutomated = false;
260
261        public static void removeUnsuitedMods(ShipVariantAPI variant, List<HullModSpecAPI> mods) {
262                removeUnsuitedMods(variant, mods, false);
263        }
264        public static void removeUnsuitedMods(ShipVariantAPI variant, List<HullModSpecAPI> mods, boolean allowNonCivOnCiv) {
265                //boolean auto = variant.hasHullMod(HullMods.AUTOMATED);
266                boolean auto = Misc.isAutomated(variant);
267                if (assumeAllShipsAreAutomated) auto = true;
268                boolean civ = variant.getHullSpec().getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.CIVILIAN);
269                //boolean phase = variant.getHullSpec().getDefenseType() == ShieldType.PHASE;
270                boolean phase = variant.getHullSpec().isPhase();
271                boolean peakTime = variant.getHullSpec().getNoCRLossTime() < 10000;
272                boolean shields = variant.getHullSpec().getDefenseType() == ShieldType.FRONT || 
273                                                  variant.getHullSpec().getDefenseType() == ShieldType.OMNI; 
274                                
275                Iterator<HullModSpecAPI> iter = mods.iterator();
276                while (iter.hasNext()) {
277                        HullModSpecAPI curr = iter.next();
278                        if (!peakTime && curr.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_PEAK_TIME)) {
279                                iter.remove();
280                                continue;
281                        }
282                        if (phase && curr.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_NOT_PHASE)) {
283                                iter.remove();
284                                continue;
285                        }
286                        if (auto && curr.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_NOT_AUTO)) {
287                                iter.remove();
288                                continue;
289                        }
290                        if (civ && curr.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_NOT_CIV)) {
291                                iter.remove();
292                                continue;
293                        }
294                        if (!allowNonCivOnCiv && civ && !curr.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_CIV) && !curr.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_CIV_ONLY)) {
295                                iter.remove();
296                                continue;
297                        }
298                        if (!civ && curr.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_CIV_ONLY)) {
299                                iter.remove();
300                                continue;
301                        }
302                        if (!shields  && curr.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_REQ_SHIELDS)) {
303                                iter.remove();
304                                continue;
305                        }
306                }
307        }
308        public static void removeModsAlreadyInVariant(ShipVariantAPI variant, List<HullModSpecAPI> mods) {
309                Iterator<HullModSpecAPI> iter = mods.iterator();
310                while (iter.hasNext()) {
311                        HullModSpecAPI curr = iter.next();
312                        if (variant.hasHullMod(curr.getId())) iter.remove();
313                }
314        }
315        
316        public static int addAllPermaModsWithTags(ShipVariantAPI variant, String ... tags) {
317                int added = 0;
318                for (HullModSpecAPI mod : getModsWithTags(tags)) {
319                        if (!variant.hasHullMod(mod.getId())) added++;
320                        variant.removeSuppressedMod(mod.getId());
321                        variant.addPermaMod(mod.getId(), false);
322                }
323                return added;
324        }
325        
326        public static List<HullModSpecAPI> getModsWithoutTags(List<HullModSpecAPI> mods, String ... tags) {
327                List<HullModSpecAPI> result = new ArrayList<HullModSpecAPI>();
328                OUTER: for (HullModSpecAPI mod : mods) {
329                        for (String tag : tags) {
330                                if (mod.hasTag(tag)) continue OUTER;
331                        }
332                        result.add(mod);
333                }
334                return result;
335        }
336        
337        public static List<HullModSpecAPI> getModsWithTags(String ... tags) {
338                List<HullModSpecAPI> result = new ArrayList<HullModSpecAPI>();
339                for (HullModSpecAPI mod : Global.getSettings().getAllHullModSpecs()) {
340                        if (mod.getTags().containsAll(Arrays.asList(tags))) {
341                                result.add(mod);
342                        }
343                }
344                return result;
345        }
346        
347        public static int getNumDMods(ShipVariantAPI variant) {
348                int count = 0;
349                for (String id : variant.getHullMods()) {
350                        if (getMod(id).hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DMOD)) count++;
351                }
352                return count;
353        }
354        
355        public static int getNumNonBuiltInDMods(ShipVariantAPI variant) {
356                int count = 0;
357                for (String id : variant.getHullMods()) {
358                        if (getMod(id).hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DMOD)) {
359                                if (variant.getHullSpec().getBuiltInMods().contains(id)) continue;
360                                count++;
361                        }
362                }
363                return count;
364        }
365        
366        public static int getNumDMods(ShipVariantAPI variant, String ... tags) {
367                int count = 0;
368                for (String id : variant.getHullMods()) {
369                        HullModSpecAPI mod = getMod(id);
370                        if (!mod.getTags().containsAll(Arrays.asList(tags))) continue;
371                        if (mod.hasTag(Tags.HULLMOD_DMOD)) count++;
372                }
373                return count;
374        }
375        
376        public static HullModSpecAPI getMod(String id) {
377                return Global.getSettings().getHullModSpec(id);
378        }
379
380        public static void removeDMod(ShipVariantAPI v, String id) {
381                ShipHullSpecAPI base = v.getHullSpec().getDParentHull();
382                
383                // so that a skin with dmods can be "restored" - i.e. just dmods suppressed w/o changing to
384                // actual base skin
385                if (!v.getHullSpec().isDefaultDHull() && !v.getHullSpec().isRestoreToBase()) {
386                        base = v.getHullSpec();
387                }
388                if (base == null && v.getHullSpec().isRestoreToBase()) {
389                        base = v.getHullSpec().getBaseHull();
390                }
391                if (base.isBuiltInMod(id)) {
392                        v.removePermaMod(id);
393                        v.addSuppressedMod(id);
394                } else {
395                        v.removePermaMod(id);
396                        v.removeMod(id);
397                }
398        }
